title: Petrodollar Cracks While Saylor Buys the Floor
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

The petrodollar is cracking and Bitcoin knows it.

Five consecutive red months—that's structurally abnormal. Bitcoin's historical ceiling is two to three losing months back-to-back. We're at five. That anomaly doesn't whisper—it reprices hard. The technical setup is undeniable: a parallel channel connecting COVID lows through 2022 through 2025, all touching the same support line. Three touches is architecture, not coincidence. $85,000 is a structural echo waiting to resolve.
